title: Event envelope, version 1
description: Fields every event on order-events, delivery-events and merchant-events carries, in snake_case. The content model is open: a consumer ignores properties it does not know, so a compatible version of an event type may add optional properties. Each event type's schema refers to this envelope and constrains event_type, aggregate_type and data.

event_id.description: Unique per event. Consumers deduplicate on it (processed_events).

event_version.description: Version of the event type's schema the producer wrote: event-schemas/<topic>/<event_type>/v<event_version>.json.

sequence.description: Position of the event among the events of its aggregate (aggregate_type, aggregate_id): 1, 2, 3, ... without gaps, in commit order, assigned by the outbox. The outbox publishes an aggregate's events in this order; consumers that keep per-aggregate state skip an event whose sequence is not above the last one they applied. Absent on events written before migration V9.

idempotency_key.description: The Idempotency-Key of the request that caused the event, when it had one.

local_date_time.description: ISO-8601 local date-time without an offset (Jackson's LocalDateTime format), in the producing instance's time zone.
